name: base-office-forms
description: BASE forms and documents kit hosted on Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:assets
scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && wrangler pages dev public
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && npm run functions:build
scripts.lint: eslint functions src tests vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts
scripts.format: prettier --write src functions/api/v2 tests scripts eslint.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.lab.config.ts vite.evidence.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc .github schemas
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src functions/api/v2 tests scripts eslint.config.mjs vite.config.ts vite.lab.config.ts vite.evidence.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.worker.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc .github schemas
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:migrations:list:preview: wrangler --config wrangler.ui2.jsonc d1 migrations list base-office-forms-ui2-preview --remote
scripts.db:migrations:list:rfi-preview: wrangler d1 migrations list base-office-forms-rfi-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run functions:build && npm run security:dependencies && npm run security:secrets
